interpretation.label: clock_relative_not_exceeded
interpretation.summary: Outcome not-E: event-minus-clock RV delta mean=-0.0912 did not clear the effective floor 0.1713 across 3 valid seeds. Coordination is no tighter around events than around arbitrary clock points -- the boundary stream reads as a detector, not the federation's coordination substrate. Informative FAIL (weakens), not a null result, per the project's non-standard-directions convention.

preconditions.name: boundary_rate_non_degenerate_band
preconditions.description: Claim-mandated non-degeneracy guard: the mean boundary-pulse rate (fraction of env steps carrying a boundary onset) must lie strictly inside the band -- neither floor-pinned (segmenter silent, no event grammar to test) nor ceiling-pinned (a boundary every step makes event-relative == clock-relative by construction).

preconditions.name: boundary_non_degenerate_seed_fraction
preconditions.description: Fraction of seeds whose own boundary rate is inside the band; a single well-placed mean must not mask per-seed pinning.

preconditions.name: sufficient_union_events_seed_fraction
preconditions.description: Fraction of seeds with >= 6 distinct union event onsets (boundary + commitment + mode-switch + offline), so peri-event pooling is not starved.

preconditions.name: sufficient_valid_seeds_for_delta_sd
preconditions.description: At least 2 seeds must clear every precondition (non-degenerate boundary rate, valid matched pools, finite RVs) to compute an SD of the event-minus-clock delta.

interpretation.scope_note: WAKING event grammar only (use_sleep_loop=False). Offline/sleep-phase transitions -- the fifth landmark class in MECH-466 -- are recorded as an available-but-empty event type this iteration and deferred to a lettered follow-up with the sleep loop enabled. Sibling of V3-EXQ-824, which deferred this Outcome E.
